$comment: A portable, secret-free fragment of ~/.claude/settings.json. provision-toolset.sh deep-merges it into your personal settings without overwriting existing keys. There are NO secrets and no mcpServers here - MCP servers are installed separately from config/mcp-manifest.json. Hooks receive their input as JSON on stdin and run in exec form (command + args) with no shell: identical behaviour on Windows and POSIX, and quotes or spaces in paths are safe. timeout is measured in SECONDS.
